title: spine-mr-finngen: Mendelian randomization pipeline for immune traits and spine-specific osteomyelitis
description: Analysis code, harmonised instrument tables, results and figures supporting the manuscript 'No robust causal effect of genetically predicted immune traits on spine-specific osteomyelitis: a two-sample Mendelian randomization study'. Pure-Python pipeline; EBI GWAS Catalog exposures, FinnGen R11 outcomes.
